name: Mathematics reel on a dark instrument frame: circle to sine, epicycles draw pi, Euler's identity builds

analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, Session C) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (27 frames), transition strips at all 5 boundaries, the listen sheet (1 dictation phrase, 12 accent hits) and 30 fps strips at 7.90-8.20 and 15.90-16.20 s (glitch cuts); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 20.0 s; two section cuts at frame level.

concept.observed: A tour of mathematical images on a dark instrument-like frame: a point on the unit circle traces a sine wave, rotating circles (epicycles) draw the letter pi beside a growing histogram, Lissajous curves with a grid of variants, a 3D surface of dots, Julia-set fractals, a sunflower spiral of dots, Euler's identity built next to its circle, then a wordmark.
concept.interpreted: The beauty of maths as vignettes of one idea drawn live.

communication_style.observed: No voice; tiny monospace labels and formulas in the corners; one equation as the climax.

palette.observed: Near-black navy (77% of pixels), cyan-teal and magenta-pink lines, violet-to-coral fractal gradients, warm gold for pi.

typography.observed: Monospace micro-labels in the frame corners (title, coordinates, formula); math italic serif for the equation; spaced capitals for the end wordmark.

composition.observed: A HUD-like frame with corner labels and rulers on every shot; one figure centred; secondary panels (histogram left, variant grid right).

motion.observed: Pen points trace curves continuously (circle to sine 2-4 s; pi drawn by epicycles 4.1-7.5 s); pi fills with a gradient (7.45-7.65 s); dots spiral outward (14.4-15.9 s); the fractal morphs its parameter (13.3-13.7 s); the equation's terms appear one by one beside a rotating radius (16.7-18.1 s) and the final 0 gets a ring.

transitions.observed: Section changes are a signal-glitch cut on whole seconds (4, 8, 10, 12, 16, 18 s; 5 detected): one frame of the outgoing picture sliced into horizontal bands with colour fringes (7.97, 15.97 s), then 3-4 frames of a lifted grey frame with scan lines (8.00-8.10, 16.00-16.10 s), clean by 8.13 and 16.13 s. At 12.0 s the fractal enters through the glitch inside a circle that expands (12.04-12.18 s). 12.81 and 13.50 s are soft in-place changes of the fractal.
transitions.interpreted: A grey 'signal' frame is the dark-frame equivalent of a white flash: it hides the edit and reads as a channel change.

timing_and_rhythm.observed: Vignettes of 2-4 s: circle 0-4, pi 4-8, curves 8-10, surface 10-12, fractal 12-14, spiral 14-16, Euler 16-18, wordmark 18-20 s.

sound_design.observed: -14.1 LUFS, LRA 1.3 LU (very even), true peak -3.6 dBTP; tempo 117.5 bpm (medium); 17 accents (51/min) on a 0.50 s grid at x.05 and x.55 s from 4.55 to 15.56 s; 2 of 5 boundaries carry an accent within 100 ms (0.40 against chance 0.16); onsets within 50 ms of boundaries 0.20 (chance 0.32), near the beat 0.40 (chance 0.24). The glitch cuts sit on whole seconds and the accent follows 50-60 ms later when present (8.06, 10.05, 12.05 s). Between cuts the accents fall while the pen draws (4.55-7.55 s) and while the spiral's dots appear (14.56-15.56 s); none after 15.56 s (the Euler section is calmer). Head and tail 4.4 dB below the body; no silences. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Beat-locked section cuts with a pulse under the drawing: a music-video grammar applied to maths.

narration.observed: None: dictation heard 2 words in 1 phrase (16.12-20.02 s) while the spiral, the equation and the black end frame show; recogniser noise over music.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: No captions. Copy: monospace micro-labels in the frame corners (about 1% of the height) and the equation e^(i pi) + 1 = 0, built term by term at mid-right beside its circle (16.7-18.1 s), the final 0 ringed in pink.

scenes.observed: Unit circle; a point turns and its height draws a sine wave.
Epicycles draw pi beside a growing histogram; pi fills.
Lissajous curves with a grid of variants.
A sunflower spiral of dots builds outward.
Euler's identity builds term by term beside its circle.

moments.observed: A point turns on the unit circle while a guide line carries its height across to draw a sine wave on the right.
moments.interpreted: Two representations shown as one motion.

moments.observed: Euler's identity builds term by term beside the circle whose half-turn it describes; the final 0 gets a ring.
moments.interpreted: The equation is read against the geometry it states.

difficult: The 3D dot surface and the fractals (per-pixel colouring at 720p is heavy for DOM/SVG; canvas or a pre-rendered plate would be needed)
uncertainties: Whether the glitch frames carry a separate sound effect
Whether pi is drawn by a true Fourier epicycle sum or a hand-animated path
